description: Sends a quote request to Denia Print for the user, like the form on the site: the team replies with a written quote, without obligation, and the user gets a confirmation by e-mail with a link to follow it. Only with the user's consent and their real contact details.

details.description: What the user needs: product, size, quantity, deadline, design or not.

lang.description: The user's language for the reply (default es).

product.description: What it is, e.g. "500 business cards" (or a slug).

name: request_quote
title: Request a quote
